purpose: Source-located development-locality markers for both comparison maps
coordinate_source_policy: Community map geography kept separate from official policy claims. No generated or token-geocoded coordinates. No satellite imagery or basemap artwork copied.
display_rules: Always show locality/vicinity qualification in the details panel.
Do not derive an extent, circle radius, acreage or eligibility boundary from these points.
Prefer the Futian Bonded Area locality marker for the broad Shenzhen Hetao card. Keep the nearby-station marker optional rather than claiming it is the HKSTP branch.
Use one default locality marker per flagship; Kulai and Sedenak are alternatives for the same flagship F.
Mainland points are OSM coordinates; no GCJ-02 or BD-09 coordinates were mixed in.
